name: Courage
overview: Scripture reveals courage as a steadfast trust in God's promises and commands, exemplified by Abraham's obedience to leave his homeland at God's call and his readiness to offer Isaac in faith. Moses demonstrates courage through his intimate relationship with God and willingness to lead despite uncertainty. Caleb encourages boldness to possess the promised land, reflecting confidence in God's enabling power. Together, these passages show that true courage arises from faith in God's guidance and grace, enabling believers to face challenges without fear.
